hook: Your brain can move a computer cursor without your hand.
title: Your Brain Can Move a Computer Cursor
description:
Neuralink patients with paralysis have moved a computer cursor using only their thoughts, shown in public demo videos. A tiny implant reads brain signals and turns them into cursor movement. Series: Facts That Sound Fake.

#Shorts #Neuralink #Technology
comment_prompt: Would you get a brain implant? Yes or no
